liebermann.description_de: Von Thorpe allein, ohne Angabe des Fundortes, benutzt
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: A manuscript used only by Thorpe, who did not say where it was
liebermann.notes: A manuscript used only by Thorpe, who gave no location and assigned it to the 13th century; from the variants he cites for ECf it had ECf retr, closest to Db.

entries.text_de: Von Thorpe12 allein, ohne Angabe des Fundortes, benutzt und dem 13. Jh. zugewiesen. Laut der von ihm nur für ECf citirten Varianten: ECf retr, u. S. 627, nächst verwandt mit Db.
entries.text_en: Used by Thorpe12 alone, without stating where it is kept, and assigned to the 13th century. According to the variants he cites only for ECf: ECf retr, below, p. 627, most closely related to Db.
